title: ഈ വണ്ടിനെ നിങ്ങൾ തിന്നിട്ടുണ്ട് You’ve Eaten This Insect Without Knowing 😱 | Rice Weevil കുറുംചാത്തൻ
description:
Have you ever noticed tiny insects inside your rice or grain containers?
In this video, we explore THREE major types of grain weevils — insects that live, grow, and reproduce inside stored grains without being noticed.

These weevils are among the most destructive stored-food pests in the world, responsible for massive food loss in homes, godowns, and warehouses.

🪲 This video covers 3 important weevils:

• Rice Weevil (Sitophilus oryzae)
• Granary Weevil (Sitophilus granarius)
• Maize Weevil (Sitophilus zeamais)

You’ll see how these insects:
• Drill into grains using their snout
• Lay eggs inside rice, wheat, and maize
• Complete their entire life cycle inside a single grain
• Turn healthy grains into hollow powder
• Spread quickly and destroy food storage systems

🔍 What you will learn:

• Differences between rice, granary, and maize weevils
• Their complete life cycle and reproduction
• Signs of grain infestation at home
• Damage caused to stored food
• Simple household and industrial prevention methods

This video is perfect for students, science enthusiasts, farmers, food-storage workers, and households.

⚠️ One infested grain can start a full infestation — early awareness is the key.
